end.parentNote: Asha practised the non-zero-parts-first method with Rudra, and they explained that the zeros are added afterward. They used the same method correctly in two attempts, but mixed up the total number of zeros in an example like 3,000 × 400, and this was still unresolved at the end. At home, practise by writing the two non-zero products and separately counting all trailing zeros before combining them.
